# Recordings of calls with real modems (format: tools/README.md), and what
# v90m-replay must make of each. Columns: file, v90m-replay options (the
# settings the call was made with), the expected "modulation ..." line of
# the replay up to the SNR, the modem, the date of the call.
#
# Each recording ends 10 to 20 ms after the modem connected: the handshake
# only, no user data. The transmit matches the recording up to the start of
# data mode (the recording modem's own data bits), except x2b: recorded
# before the fixes of 2026-11-16 for that modem, it is answered differently
# from 18.4 s on, and goes on to connect at V.34 as the modem does today.
# -Q (0.7.4, V90M_OPT_NO_QC) on the V.92 ones: they were answered without
# Quick Connect, and usr6's and usr7's U.S. Robotics 5686 sent a QC1a
# (octet 0x88) ahead of its CM, which 0.7.4 would take.
cxa.raw.xz   -9 -Q -u 33600 modulation 7, 50666 bit/s down, 25333 up   Conexant CX93001 (USB), AT+PIG=0          2026-11-16
v34a.raw.xz                modulation 5, 31200 bit/s down, 28800 up   Conexant CX93001 (USB), V.34 forced       2026-11-15
v21a.raw.xz                modulation 1, 300 bit/s down, 300 up       Conexant CX93001 (USB), V.21 forced       2026-11-15
usr7.raw.xz  -9 -Q         modulation 7, 54666 bit/s down, 40000 up   U.S. Robotics 5686, firmware 5.4.62       2026-11-16
usr6.raw.xz  -9 -Q -u 32000 modulation 7, 54666 bit/s down, 32000 up   U.S. Robotics 5686, firmware 5.4.62       2026-11-16
x2r2.raw.xz  -9 -Q -u 33600 modulation 4, 54666 bit/s down, 28800 up   U.S. Robotics 56K of 1998, flash 5.1.4    2026-11-16
x2b.raw.xz   -9 -Q -u 33600 modulation 5, 28800 bit/s down, 28800 up   U.S. Robotics 56K of 1998, flash 5.1.4    2026-11-16
#
# usrc1 is a call that did not connect, kept for what the modem makes of its
# Phase 3: the caller's S in answer to Jd came half a symbol late on a line
# that tilts the band, and was not taken (P34_ERR_NO_S2 at 14.033 s) before
# the fix of 2026-11-25; with it Jd' and the DIL follow at 11.867 s. The
# recording ends there: the caller had given up (its Tone A from 12.5 s).
# From a packet capture at the answering host (RTP, G.711 mu-law, through
# an FXS gateway); the host sent through v90m_process_linear and its own
# G.711 encoder, so the transmit differs from the replay's in rounding.
usrc1.raw.xz -r 3000 -d 0 -s 0   modulation 0, 0 bit/s down, 0 up   U.S. Robotics Courier V.Everything, FXS gateway   2026-11-25
